title: Article 42 — Provision for just and humane conditions of work and maternity relief

content.overview: Article 42 directs the State to make provision for securing just and humane conditions of work and for maternity relief.

sections.heading: Directive content
sections.body: Labour and maternity standards are primarily statutory. Related: Art 37.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Implement through statute or scheme. Article 37 bars treating this Directive Principle as a freestanding justiciable right.
